stem: What happens next in this passage after “A few had interesting parts.”?
options: The school changed its bell to a short song written by students.
They chose the work that showed the clearest human decision.
The stars had not changed much, but human understanding had.
The band chose one phrase, changed it, added human lyrics, and built a song around it.
